title: Zolani Mahola & The Feminine Force featuring Karen Zoid
summary: Zolani Mahola and her band The Feminine Force welcome special guest Karen Zoid to the Stanford Hills Sunset Sessions stage.
description: Start the holidays with an evening of music and togetherness at Stanford Hills Estate. Zolani Mahola and her band, The Feminine Force, welcome special guest Karen Zoid to the stage for a celebration of diversity and sisterhood. As the sun sets over the farm, enjoy powerful vocals, moving songs and the energy of these artists sharing the stage. Bring a blanket, gather your friends and family, and settle in for a memorable Sunset Sessions show. Gates open: 15:00. Performance: 18:00. Adults: R350. Children aged 5–13: R200. Children under 5: Free. Outside food and drinks are not permitted.
